name: v3.2.0
body:
## Highlights

- **iOS browsing:** Drive, Photos, Starred and Shared have collapsing large-title headers. Drive home has Archive/Locked/Trash tiles, an image-first Recents rail and compact folder tiles.
- **Folders, Starred and Shared:** folder pages have a glass back button and breadcrumbs, Starred uses the Drive layout, and Shared groups links into Active and Expired or Revoked with status and counts.
- **Recovery spaces:** Archive, Locked and Trash match the new design, with clear empty and error states.
- **Theme:** the iOS palette now matches UIKit system colors, with one system-blue accent, consistent tints for each destination, and Increase Contrast support.
- **Photos:** the categories use the native segmented control, and the search toggle animates without stutter.
- **Controls:** row overflow menus are lighter, and header controls respond immediately inside scrolling content.

## What's Changed
* Release 3.2.0: iOS browsing redesign and UIKit-aligned palette by @SreejanPersonal in https://github.com/ShekhawatPriya/TeleDrive/pull/3


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShekhawatPriya/TeleDrive/compare/v3.1.3...v3.2.0

name: v3.1.3
body:
## Highlights

- **Photos and library:** refined library browsing, animated gallery density changes with smoother scrolling, and improved native video playback.
- **Account:** saved Telegram profile photos refresh automatically, and the Telegram connection details are better organized.
- **Browsing:** unified recovery states and shared-item interactions.
- **About:** public release history is shown in About, with expandable release notes.
- **iOS:** refined accessibility and native navigation.
- **Security:** includes the authentication and transfer hardening from the previous mainline.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShekhawatPriya/TeleDrive/compare/v3.1.2...v3.1.3

name: v3.1.1
body:
## Sharing
- Choose Share a copy to send original files through the system share sheet, or Create link to retain public-link sharing.
- See download progress, cancel preparation, and retry failures. Original filenames and file types are preserved, including multi-file selections.
- Keep folder and mixed selections on link sharing, with separate revocation for existing links.
- Prevent stale account selections, cancelled downloads, and incomplete originals from reaching the share sheet.

## Photos
- Drag the information panel freely, interrupt flings, and resize or close it with the persistent grip.
- Preserve photo aspect ratio, zoom, and pan while opening and closing information.
- Use consistent native iOS Share, Star, Info, and Delete controls with accessible targets.
- Reduce repeated gallery grouping and avoid cache scans after photo decoding.

## Accounts and interface
- Show account confirmations only after device authorization completes.
- Improve confirmation banner placement, wrapping, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior.
- Clarify the iOS Revoke link action with the native trash symbol.

## Documentation
- Add guides for copy/link sharing and running TeleDrive on a physical phone.
- Add photo-viewer, sharing, account-banner, and native iOS regression fixtures.

## Release
Version 3.1.1, build 7. No local tests, builds, linters, or validation commands were run for this commit-and-release request. The existing tag-triggered GitHub workflow handles Android packaging and the update manifest. No iOS IPA is included.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShekhawatPriya/TeleDrive/compare/v3.1.0...v3.1.1


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShekhawatPriya/TeleDrive/compare/v3.1.0...v3.1.1

name: v3.1.0
body:
## Photos
- Add horizontal photo swiping and a scrub-enabled thumbnail strip.
- Reveal an expandable information panel by swiping up or tapping Info.
- Keep share and delete at the edges with grouped iOS star and Info controls.
- Remove the landscape letterbox gap when opening details.

## Android and sharing
- Refine Settings, appearance choices, narrow layouts and large text.
- Improve shared/starred indicators and show login country flags.
- Browse nested shared folders with explicit file types and metadata.

## Release
Version 3.1.0, build 6. The GitHub release workflow publishes the Android APK and update manifest when packaging completes. iOS changes are included in source; no IPA is included.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ShekhawatPriya/TeleDrive/compare/v3.0.6...v3.1.0
